evilradio.name: EvilRadio
evilradio.description: Here you find all Widgets related to the Evil-Radio Addon

menu.title: Our Stations
menu.description: You want to hear a song, but no moderator is live? No problem!
menu.description2: Click on the station and request your song. Wait a moment, and it will be played.

wheel.scrollInfo: Mouse wheel ↑↓: Change volume | Middle click: Play/Pause

streamSelected.title: Stream selected
streamSelected.text: The stream has been started successfully.

limitTitleLength.name: Limit Title Length
limitTitleLength.description: Limit the length of the title. Prevents the title from being too long and potentially taking up too much space on the screen.

maxTitleLength.name: Max Title Length
maxTitleLength.description: Set the character limit of the Song Title. When set to 0 the title length is unlimited.

backgroundColor.name: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: Color and transparency of the widget background. Fully transparent keeps the background invisible.

enabled.name: Enable Addon
enabled.description: Enable or disable the Evil-Radio Addon

radioMenuKeybind.name: Radio Menu Keybind
radioMenuKeybind.description: Key to open the radio menu

showSongChangeNotification.name: Song Change Notification
showSongChangeNotification.description: Get a notification when the song changes

autoStopOnFocusLoss.name: Auto-Stop on Focus Loss
autoStopOnFocusLoss.description: Automatically stop the stream when the game window loses focus

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: The volume of the radio stream (0-100%)

autoStart.name: Auto-Start Settings
autoStart.description: Configure automatic start of the last stream

enabled.name: Enable Auto-Start
enabled.description: Enable automatic start of the last played stream

mode.name: Auto-Start Mode
mode.description: Choose when the stream should automatically start

delay.name: Auto-Start Delay
delay.description: Delay in seconds before automatically starting the stream (0-10 seconds)

usageStatistics.name: Usage-based Sorting
usageStatistics.description: Manage usage statistics and sorting of streams

enabled.name: Usage-based Sorting
enabled.description: Sort stations based on usage frequency

resetStatistics.name: Reset Statistics
resetStatistics.description: Resets the usage statistics of the streams

reloadStreams.name: Reload Streams (only if you have problems)
reloadStreams.description: Reloads the stream list from the server. Only use if you have problems.
